steps.title: Stack south of the boss
steps.rule: Group up just south of Lindwurm and watch which of the eight clones gets tethered to you: its spot decides your job.

steps.title: Take your clone's tether
steps.cue: Six lindschrat appear around the boss
steps.rule: Your clone's spot is your job. North clone: take the boss tether on Lindwurm. South clone: no tether, run to the south wall. The other six take the tether matching their clone and stand just inside that lindschrat: east-side clones (NE cone, E stack, SE defamation) take the first match going clockwise from the north lindschrat, west-side clones (NW cone, W stack, SW defamation) the first match going counter-clockwise from the north-west one.

steps.title: Line up for Firefall Splash
steps.rule: Boss tether: go north so Lindwurm lands there. Cones stand at the north wall just beside the middle, stacks a bit further out beside them, each on their own side. Defamations go to their side's wall (east or west); the untethered player stays at the south wall.

steps.title: Light party stacks
steps.rule: Split east and west of Lindwurm into light-party stacks for Heavy Slam: the west group is the west clones plus the south clone, the east group the east clones plus the boss tether. Cones stand on the outer edge of their stack.

steps.title: Behind the boss
steps.rule: Everyone runs behind Lindwurm to the north wall to dodge Snaking Kick.

steps.title: Back to your clone spot
steps.rule: Cones and stacks return to their Firefall spots at the north wall. The defamations and their partners (south clone to the west, boss tether to the east) wait together north-west or north-east of the boss.

steps.title: Bait Netherwrath
steps.cue: Netherwrath Near or Netherwrath Far cast starts
steps.rule: Cones and stacks hold. Each defamation takes Timeless Spite with its partner sharing it: on Near the defamation stands closest to the boss with the partner just outside, on Far the defamation goes furthest out toward the wall with the partner just inside.

steps.title: Melee NE, ranged NW
steps.rule: Melee go to the north-east wall, behind the north-east clone, clear of the south-west clone's defamation replay.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to the north-west wall, clear of the south-west clone's defamation replay.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to the north-west wall, clear of the south-west clone's defamation replay.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to the north-west wall, clear of the south-west clone's defamation replay.

CasterDps.rule: Go to the north-west wall, clear of the south-west clone's defamation replay.

steps.title: Stack on the replayed stacks
steps.cue: The north-east clone's Hemorrhagic Projection resolves
steps.rule: Melee stack on B to share the east clone's Heavy Slam replay.

RegenHealer.rule: Stack on D to share the west clone's Heavy Slam replay.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stack on D to share the west clone's Heavy Slam replay.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Stack on D to share the west clone's Heavy Slam replay.

CasterDps.rule: Stack on D to share the west clone's Heavy Slam replay.

steps.title: Melee dodge north-east
steps.rule: Melee move up to the north-east wall, away from the south-east clone's defamation replay; ranged stay on D.

steps.title: Regroup south of the boss
steps.cue: The last Hemorrhagic Projection replay resolves
steps.rule: Everyone groups up just south of the centre again.
